name: CodeBlock
summary: Mono-typeface code display with optional language label, line numbers, copy button, and token highlight. For inline single-token code, use `<code>` or the Kbd primitive. CodeBlock is the multi-line variant. Renders pre-formatted whitespace, wraps on long lines via wrap='wrap' or 'soft', and exposes copy via CopyButton.

code.description: The raw source text. Preserves whitespace. Use a string with explicit \n line breaks.

language.description: Lowercase identifier (ts / tsx / sh / json / sql). Renders an eyebrow-mono label in the top-left. Highlighting itself is left to the consumer (Shiki, Prism, hljs).

highlightLines.description: Comma-separated 1-indexed line numbers and/or ranges to highlight ('3,7-9'). Highlighted rows get a faint accent left-stripe.

wrap.description: scroll: overflow-x: auto (default; code stays on one line per source line). soft: wrap at word boundaries. wrap: wrap at character (only for ASCII art / fixed-width).

copy.description: Renders the CopyButton in the top-right.

filename.description: Optional filename label in the top-left, replaces language label.

maxHeight.description: CSS height (e.g. 320px). Beyond this, scroll is exposed. Pair with copy=true so the user can still grab the full content.

keyboard: Tab - move focus to copy button (when copy=true)
Tab - move focus into the pre (region) so SR users can read the contents
rules: Root has role='region' and aria-label='Code block, {language|filename}'.
<pre><code> for the body — SR users hear 'preformatted text'.
Copy button has aria-label='Copy code'. On success, aria-live='polite' announces 'Copied'.
Long blocks should remain scrollable (don't force-wrap code by default — wrapping destroys diff-readability).
Highlight stripes are decorative; the highlighted line still needs to read normally.

do: Use CodeBlock for any 2+ line snippet.
Use language='shell' for terminal output and prefix lines with $ when interactive.
Always include CopyButton — code is meant to be reused.
Use maxHeight + scroll for long examples; expose copy so the user can still grab everything.
Use highlight stripes sparingly to draw the eye to the relevant line — never highlight more than 1/3 of the block.
dont: Don't render inline single-token code in CodeBlock. Use <code> or Kbd.
Don't auto-wrap code — diff readability matters more than horizontal compactness.
Don't strip the copy button to save space. The copy button IS the point of CodeBlock.
Don't color tokens outside the standard syntax theme (Shiki / Prism). Inline custom colors break dark mode and consistency.

changelog.note: Initial CodeBlock contract. Language / filename label, line numbers, line highlight, copy button, wrap modes, max-height scroll.
